gates.reason: The other consistency exit codes need a LIVE browser to reach: 2 (rig-broken — a canary that finds fewer contradictions than expected), 6 (app-error — a journey action throwing), and 4 (ledger-persist-failed — a disk/permission failure) all require actually driving Playwright against a running app or forcing an I/O failure, none of which is hermetically deterministic under the cli-exit fixture. Exit 3 (fatal-rig, missing manifest) IS bound executably above; these are document-only, blocked on a live browser / injected I/O failure.

'personaFindingHash() is the single source' — the same hash computed identically on both the correlator and report sides — is a same-function-identity guarantee. There is no cli-exit for it, and while a unit-seam oracle could import personaFindingHash and assert stability, the closed registry has no general 'assert this function is the sole hash producer' oracle; a cli-exit recipe cannot bind a code-identity invariant.

'NEVER include typed input values … the store rejects any' is enforced at the STORE boundary (a server-side rejection), not by the persona-test skill's own CLI. Asserting it would mean exercising the store's validation, which is a different subsystem's contract, not persona-test's exit behaviour; document-only here.
